host: Bluent.UI.Demo WebAssembly, built from current task branch source with Debug configuration
scope: Actual Chromium CDP DOM/AX-tree and keyboard observations for typed fields; OTP paste uses a synthetic ClipboardEvent; forced-colors is emulated; no native screen-reader or OS contrast certification.

checks.name: LIGHT-LTR fields real header controls apply theme/direction and forced-colors media
LIGHT-LTR OTP group exposes group role and Verification code name
LIGHT-LTR OTP cells expose English positional labels and numeric one-time-code metadata
LIGHT-LTR OTP browser AX exposes each cell as a named textbox
LIGHT-LTR OTP hidden bound input and displayed value start empty
OTP typing one digit updates hidden binding and advances focus
OTP sequential typing updates two cells and bound value
OTP Backspace on an empty cell clears the previous digit and moves focus back
OTP synthetic paste distributes digits, updates hidden binding and focuses final cell
OTP input handler strips non-digit text and updates bound value
OTP ArrowLeft moves focus to the previous cell
